newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: John Keells sees early foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: John Keells sees early foreign buying.

text.p: John Keells Holdings Ltd saw early foreign buying as 175,000 shares were sold at 192 rupees, brokers said.
The share last traded at 193 rupees.
"It is a foreign buyer who has been buying the scrip whenever he can get quantity, because he thinks it offers good value at current levels," said a broker.
The share rose to over 400 rupees when the market rallied in early 1994.
The company is one of three blue chip conglomerates listed on the Colombo bourse. --Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
